name: Monotonic Projected Minimum Teaching Set Size / Minimum Projected Teaching Set Size
proof: The monotonic projected variant takes an additional maximum over subfamilies.  Taking the original class as the subfamily recovers the ordinary projected minimum teaching-set size.
witness_verification: For C_pt, TS_min^p=2, while the four-concept subfamily {1000,0100,0010,0001} has value 3 and exhaustive enumeration shows TS_min^{*p}=3; sync/verify_projected_teaching_values.py verifies both.
